row.notes: Same idiom in the setup screen function that calls UpdateFuelRange at 0x140c1cbb5 (before UpdateDiffHighSpeedRange). cmp dword [rax+0x9f40],0x64 on the car of the car setup screen: rax = [[vm+0x268]+0x28], 0 when the setup data has no car.
